build: Untagged development build before the v0.1.0 baseline
method: Actual installed Pi launcher in a PTY, isolated agent home and character folder, credential-free local OpenAI-compatible fixture
checks: Package loads and character/date/memory/alternative widget is visible
Cancelling missing-date input restores the complete crafted opening in the editor
Successful character reply uses configured local model
Ctrl+Alt+R generates a second alternative and preserves an unsent draft
Ctrl+Alt+Left selects the first saved alternative and preserves the draft
Ctrl+Alt+M opens the character and memory menu
Personality opens in the multiline editor and saves with visible confirmation
Memorize completes with a visible success notice and memorized widget state
Delete confirms, removes the chat and its native memory contribution, and opens a fresh linked chat
Scrollable custom memory inspector loads through the installed Pi runtime and closes with Enter
limitations: Deterministic fixture verifies interaction and integration, not external model prose quality
No user models, credentials or character data were changed by the terminal smoke
